# Secondhand Market

> A marketplace where people list things they no longer want, chat with a buyer, and agree on a sale.

**Stack:** Next.js + SQLite — One project runs both the screens and the server, and the database is a single file you can delete and start over.

## 내 AI 팀

**🧠 Architect** (Claude Code) — Decides how the app is put together and what the data looks like, before anyone writes a feature. — `docs/**`
  → .agents/architect.md

**🎨 UI Developer** (Claude Code) — Builds the screens people actually click on. — `app/**`, `components/**`
  → .agents/ui.md

**⚙️ Feature Developer** (Codex) — Builds login, the database, and everything that happens behind the screens. — `server/**`, `db/**`
  → .agents/feature.md

**🔍 Reviewer** (Claude Code) — Checks the others' work for bugs and missing pieces before you call it done. — `tests/**`
  → .agents/reviewer.md

## 진행 순서

- 1단계: 🧠 Plan the structure
- 2단계: ⚙️ Build the database and login · 🎨 Build the screens
  이 작업들은 서로 상관이 없습니다. 그래도 하나씩 하세요 — 같은 폴더에서 둘을 동시에 돌리면 서로의 작업을 덮어씁니다.
- 3단계: 🔍 Check the whole thing
- 4단계: 🙋 Try it yourself
